dialogues.speaker: Amina
dialogues.text: Nice weather we're having, eh? Have you had a hot spring bath today?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me a little about yourself...

dialogues.speaker: Amina
dialogues.text: I'm Amina, the chief of the People of the Springs.

dialogues.speaker: Amina
dialogues.text: Hey, what's with that shocked face? I'm doing my job with all seriousness, mind you!

dialogues.speaker: Amina
dialogues.text: Know this — seriousness is a rare virtue among us.

dialogues.speaker: Amina
dialogues.text: The other are either still bathing, or on their way to take a bath.

dialogues.speaker: Amina
dialogues.text: If you find someone lazing about without awareness of the situation, just come find me. I'll take responsibility as chief!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hello there, Amina.

dialogues.speaker: Amina
dialogues.text: Hehe, here to see me, are you?

dialogues.speaker: Amina
dialogues.text: Everything's going great here. No accidents reported, and the kids have... mostly stopped throwing stones into the hot springs...

dialogues.speaker: Amina
dialogues.text: Forget it. No point dwelling on sad affairs. As my grandfather said, positivity should be our guiding star!

dialogues.speaker: Amina
dialogues.text: In truth... I've been pretty busy lately, designing a new stage, reinforcing patrols, and such.

dialogues.speaker: Amina
dialogues.text: A crazy amount of ideas have been coming to mind, to be honest. I'm just hoping Manua doesn't come up with any more!

dialogues.speaker: Amina
dialogues.text: Ah, right! While I'm sure Mualani would invite you over anyway, let me just say: Don't forget to swing by often!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll go take a dip shortly.

dialogues.speaker: Amina
dialogues.text: That's what I'm talking about!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How have you been lately?

dialogues.speaker: Amina
dialogues.text: Thanks for asking. With everyone's help, I'm sure it'll all start taking a turn for the better.

dialogues.speaker: Amina
dialogues.text: After the war ended, many people were gone... I just hope they all went to the same place as Auntie Atea. The more the merrier, after all!

dialogues.speaker: Amina
dialogues.text: ...Sorry, that probably sounds a bit naive. But I really believe that people from Natlan will be reunited in the Night Kingdom after they've passed.

dialogues.speaker: Amina
dialogues.text: This explains how Ancient Names are forged from the memories of heroes and passed down through the ages.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How have you been lately?

dialogues.speaker: Amina
dialogues.text: Quite well. Thanks for asking. Thanks to everyone's hard work, this place is as busy as ever, hehe!

dialogues.speaker: Amina
dialogues.text: Many people left us when all was said and done... I just hope they all went to the same place as Auntie Atea. The more the merrier, after all!

dialogues.speaker: Amina
dialogues.text: ...Sorry, that probably sounds a bit naive. But I really believe that we, the people of Natlan, will be reunited in the Night Kingdom after our passing.

dialogues.speaker: Amina
dialogues.text: That's how Ancient Names are forged from the memories of heroes and passed down through the ages.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Reliable indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Amina
dialogues.text: And I'm not just bragging, y'hear? If you come up with any comments or suggestions while having fun here in our land, feel free to tell me any time.

dialogues.speaker: Amina
dialogues.text: Who knows? We might have already exactly what you're looking for by the time you come back around.

dialogues.speaker: Amina
dialogues.text: By the way, do take these souvenirs with you as mementos of your time here.
